info.name: Arcade Hub API
info.description:
Every endpoint in api/src/app.ts, for the M5 RESTful-design demo check.

Setup: start MongoDB and the API (see CLAUDE.md, Commands), then run
`node tests/postman/prepare-fixtures.mjs` to write the two tiny synthetic
upload files the collection sends. Neither is a real game or save, and both
are gitignored.

Run the whole collection in order; it registers fresh accounts, adds a game,
plays it, saves, resumes, checks ownership errors, then deletes the game.
Saves have no delete endpoint, so each run leaves two saves behind under a
fresh account. Set fixturesDir to an absolute path when running in the
Postman app; the default is relative to the repo root for Newman.
